title: Your account
photoNoWorkspace: Join or create a workspace to add a photo: it is shown on your card there.
photoHint: Shown next to your name in every workspace: meetings, directory, minutes. A square picture works best; it is cropped to its centre.
name: Name
passwordChanged: Password changed. Your other devices were signed out.
noPassword: You sign in without a password (email link or single sign-on). To add one, use “Forgot password?” on the sign-in page.
twoFactorHint: Ask for a code from an authenticator app at each sign-in.
twoFactorNeedsPassword: Two-step verification protects password sign-in: set a password first.
scan: Scan this code with your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
secret: Or enter this key by hand:
backupHint: Keep these codes somewhere safe: each one lets you sign in once without your phone.
sessionsHint: Sign out of every browser and device, this one included.
noWorkspace: You are not in any workspace yet.
calendarHint: A private link with every meeting you take part in, for your calendar app.
upgradeHintsShow: Show the features of the paid plans in the settings
upgradeHintsHint: Only the people who run a workspace or pay for it see them, and never during a meeting.
weeklyLabel: Send me a summary of my week every Monday
weeklyHint: My sessions, my open actions and the kudos I received, by email, only when there is something to tell.
passkeysHint: Sign in with your device's lock (face, fingerprint or PIN) instead of a password. Your password manager can keep them on all your devices.
passkeyAdded: Passkey added: use it next time you sign in.
passkeyUnsupported: This browser cannot create passkeys. Try a recent Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.
